_about: App crash signatures already dealt with, read by scripts/crashes.py, the digest and health.py. signature is the top AncientTrees frame as crashes.py prints it, on the store build it fired on. fix_commit / first_fixed_build: the code fix and the first build that carries it. server_remedy / contained_at: a server-side fix that stops it without a new build, and when it was applied; crashes before contained_at count as answered. A run that fixes a crash adds its entry here in the same change. Android and the app's own reports (scripts/app_crashes.py, 2026-11-20) match on platform + signature as that script prints it, covering "builds" or every build below "first_fixed_build".

fixes.what: empty-tree feedback crash at launch: MyVotes.treeId took [0] of an empty split (WorthIt.swift:84)
fixes.server_remedy: a general feedback row holds tree='' again: re-run the PATCH submissions?kind=eq.feedback&tree=eq. with {"tree": null} (service key)
